cues.headline: Rapid!
cues.body: Emil Yarrow just flew past at 26 km/h, the fastest of the match.

cues.headline: What a pass!
cues.body: Emil Yarrow just played the hardest pass of the match so far.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 5.0 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 6.4 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: GOAL! Goran Yarrow!
cues.body: Corrin Bay score! It's Ashvale Town 0–1 Corrin Bay. It had been coming: Corrin Bay were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Ashvale Town 59%, Corrin Bay 41%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: Ashvale Town turn the screw
cues.body: Ashvale Town are calling the shots now: recovering the ball 4 times in the final third, forcing Corrin Bay into 5 losses in their own half and winning the ball back in the opposition half 4 times in the last 5 minutes. Just what Ashvale Town need while they're behind.

cues.headline: Goran Yarrow scores!
cues.body: Get in! Ashvale Town 0–2 Corrin Bay. Against the run of play: Ashvale Town were in control. A long ball over the press set it up.

cues.headline: All square out there
cues.body: It's even again: over the last 5 minutes Ashvale Town have had the ball 37% of the time, Corrin Bay 63%.

cues.headline: It's in! Goran Yarrow!
cues.body: Goran Yarrow finds the net for Corrin Bay: Ashvale Town 0–3 Corrin Bay. A long ball over the press set it up.

recap.headline: Full time: Ashvale Town 0–3 Corrin Bay
recap.summary: A deserved win for Corrin Bay.
